question: Soft iron and steel are available for making magnetic devices. Which one is preferred for an electromagnet and which one for a permanent magnet? Justify your answer using magnetic properties.

options.A: Steel is preferred for an electromagnet because it has high retentivity, and soft iron is preferred for a permanent magnet because it loses magnetism quickly.
options.B: Soft iron and steel are equally suitable for both devices because retentivity and coercivity are not important magnetic properties.
options.C: Soft iron is preferred for an electromagnet because it has high permeability and low retentivity, so it magnetises and demagnetises easily. Steel is preferred for a permanent magnet because it has high retentivity and high coercivity, so it retains magnetisation and resists demagnetisation.
options.D: Soft iron is preferred for both electromagnets and permanent magnets because low retentivity is required in both cases.
